project.name: SASchi-Roku
project.description: SAS toolkit foundation: preserved Rosetta Code reference, portable migration workflow skills and a source-backed resource catalog. MCP remains planned, plus the reference-home layers: a stamp-synced knowledge base, the harvested page-pinned SAS 9.4 reference, and the advisory MCP server (sas-ref-mcp).

tools.description: DMF invariant linter: fences, pointers, manifests, status lines, style floor.
MediaWiki harvest pipeline: refresh or check the corpus against Category:SAS upstream (tools/fetch_rosetta_sas.py).
Validate resource records, generated catalog and compatibility paths (scripts/check_toolkit.py).
Knowledge sync: pull canonical copies into kb/ with SOURCE.json stamps; --check verifies them offline (tools/sync_knowledge.py).
Reference harvester: the SAS 9.4 docsets into page-pinned kb/reference/ entries, reconciled against the capability manifest; deterministic regeneration gate in CI (tools/fetch_sas_reference.py).
Advisory knowledge and skills MCP server over the kb/ layers: twelve tools, nine resources, three prompts; self-test via python -m sas_ref.mcp.selftest (mcp/ subproject).
Sanitization token gate for this instance's allowed identity, with declared exemptions and an adjudicated allowlist (scripts/check_sanitization.py buntas).
